title: Take a Trip to The Strip: Summer Offerings at Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas Resorts
summary: *Photos can be found here * LAS VEGAS (July 1, 2026) From brunch to cant-miss show deals, Caesars Entertainments Las Vegas resorts are giving guests an excuse to visit The Strip all summer long. Special hotel offers for America250 In celebration of Americas 250th anniversary, guests can score special hotel offers for future stays. Red, White and a Free Night Guests who book a two-night stay can receive 10% off at any Las Vegas resort. During their stay, guests can sign up for the Caesars Rewards(r) loyalty program and earn a free night on a future stay. Guests must book by Monday, Aug. 31, for stays through Sept. 30, 2026. Americas 250th Military and Veteran Offer Veterans and active military can receive up to 15% off lowest available hotel rates. Guests must verify military status through ID.me .
